html: Reconciliation of the third review pass, of v0.6.0, before first publication; the check found no grade demonstrably wrong. Rubric v1.4: the High precondition names the statistics of each property and the build tests every cited study against its own property's list (nine studies leave the tables on four cells; every one of those cells keeps two or more and stays High); high_basis is renamed precondition_evidence, the studies that meet the precondition, and a cell that drops from High keeps that evidence in its history; internal consistency on item sets and derived indices is stated; a flag descriptor may name a population by the survey, trial or organisation that sampled it; a direct reason lists a working-adult sample first; the rule that borrowed evidence never grades High is now checked; every rule names its check and the unchecked ones are listed. One High grade drops to Moderate (k10 criterion validity against a reference standard, on a credible published disagreement, the rater's judgement written on the cell), two internal-consistency cells become Not-applicable (wpai, fcs-maps), two population tags and two evidence forms are corrected. All 420 DOIs resolved. Schema 0.7: eight-field previous blocks. Logged as correction C-0007 with the rubric 1.3 values kept on each changed cell. No fresh literature search: as-of dates unchanged.
